You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

{"scenario":"Brook Post subscriptions","question":"Can the incident lead close a postal service ticket?","claims":{"A":"The ticket intake had zero original delivery complaints.","B":"The print room released 140 replacement issues on Monday.","C":"All 140 replacement issues were delivered on Tuesday."},"handoff":"{\"claims\":{\"A\":{\"status\":\"contradicted\",\"citations\":[\"S3\"]},\"B\":{\"status\":\"supported\",\"citations\":[\"S1\"]},\"C\":{\"status\":\"unresolved\",\"citations\":[\"S2\"]}},\"note\":\"S3 records 37 original delivery complaints, contradicting claim A of zero complaints. S1 confirms 140 replacement issues were released Monday, supporting claim B. S2 states replacements should arrive Tuesday but does not confirm all 140 were delivered, leaving claim C unresolved. Therefore, the incident lead cannot definitively close the postal service ticket based on these records.\"}","follow_up":{"S4":"an independent postal receipt reconciliation shows 140 of 140 individual replacement issues delivered on Tuesday."}}

Claim B was supported by S1, confirming 140 replacement issues released Monday. Claim C was initially unresolved based on S2, which only indicated replacements should arrive Tuesday. The follow-up source S4 provides independent reconciliation confirming all 140 replacements were delivered Tuesday, supporting claim C. With all replacements delivered, the incident lead can now close the postal service ticket."}

parsed.note: The initial handoff established that claim A was contradicted by S3, which recorded 37 original delivery complaints. Claim B was supported by S1, confirming 140 replacement issues released Monday. Claim C was initially unresolved based on S2, which only indicated replacements should arrive Tuesday. The follow-up source S4 provides independent reconciliation confirming all 140 replacements were delivered Tuesday, supporting claim C. With all replacements delivered, the incident lead can now close the postal service ticket.
